title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining a well-established international manufacturing business with operations across Europe and a reputation for delivering high-quality products to a global customer base.Due to additional resource requirements within the finance team, an opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join the business on a permanent contract. This role offers excellent exposure across transactional finance, reconciliations and month-end support within a structured and supportive finance environment.Your new role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the finance department.This is a varied position combining Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control and Finance Administration responsibilities, offering broad exposure across the finance function.Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Managing supplier invoice processing and resolving discrepancies
- Allocating customer payments and cash receipts
- Supporting credit control activities and chasing outstanding payments
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding account queries
- Processing invoices through SAP and ensuring supporting documentation is complete
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation
- Performing supplier, customer, intercompany and bank reconciliations
- Supporting month-end accounting processes
- Assisting with accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and management account schedules
- Producing reports and supporting management presentations
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar finance role
- Purchase Ledger and/or Sales Ledger experience
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience processing invoices and completing reconciliations
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Ability to work independently and manage workloads effectively

Desirable
- Credit Control experience
- SAP experience
- AAT qualification or studies
- Exposure to month-end processes

What you'll get in return
- Opportunity to join a large international business
- Broad exposure across transactional and month-end accounting activities
- Experience working with SAP and multi-entity operations
- Supportive finance team
- Career development opportunities
- Exposure to management reporting and financial analysis

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click "Apply Now" to submit your CV, or contact William Loring at Hays Accountancy & Finance for a confidential discussion.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Trainee HR Administrator
description:
Thinking About a Career Change? Why Not Choose HR?

If you've reached a crossroads in your professional life and are looking for a fresh start in a people-focused, rewarding industry then Human Resources might be exactly what you're looking for.

Many of our candidates come from diverse professional backgrounds retail, customer service, administration, healthcare, education, hospitality, and more. What they all have in common is the desire to do meaningful work, support others, and build a stable, long-term career.

Our HR Career Change Programme

We specialise in helping individuals transition into HR-starting with recognised qualifications and ending with real job opportunities.

Whether you're working full-time, part-time, or in between roles, our online learning and personalised recruitment support can help you make a successful move into the HR profession often in just a few months.

Please note that this is a training course and fees apply.

Why Human Resources?

The HR profession is growing steadily across all sectors. As businesses put more focus on employee wellbeing, development, and company culture, skilled HR professionals are more important than ever.

Even entry-level roles in HR offer strong salaries, clear progression routes, and opportunities to specialise over time (in areas like learning & development, recruitment, employee relations, and more).

Here are typical UK salaries at various stages of the HR journey:
- HR Administrator - £27,000+
- HR Assistant - £30,000+
- HR Officer - £35,000+
- HR Advisor - £38,500+
- HR Manager - £55,000+

And with hybrid and remote roles increasingly common in HR, the flexibility is there too.

How It Works - Your 3 Step Journey Into HR

Step 1 - CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice

The CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice is the industry-standard entry point into Human Resources. It's assignment-based (no exams), and is delivered fully online with expert tutor support.
- Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel & Development (CIPD)
- Covers recruitment, employee relations, HR systems, and more
- Complete in approx. 10-12 weeks at your own pace

This course not only boosts your employability-it also gives you the confidence and credibility to take the leap into a new industry.

Step 2 - Tailored Recruitment Support

Once you're qualified, our Recruitment Support Team will help you translate your background and new qualification into real job opportunities.

We've been helping career changers break into new roles since 2007-and our 4.8 Trustpilot rating shows how serious we are about your success.

You'll get:
- A professionally written, HR-focused CV
- Job-matching advice tailored to your experience and location
- Application support, interview prep, and mock interviews
- Ongoing 1-to-1 guidance to help you land your first HR role

Step 3 - Start Your New HR Career

Most of our candidates secure their first HR job within 3-6 months of qualifying-and often sooner if they're based near a major town or city.

And to give you confidence, we offer a Money Back Guarantee:
If we can't help you secure a role within 12 months of passing your qualification, we'll refund your training fees.

Flexible, Affordable, Achievable

To make things easier, we offer flexible payment options to spread the cost of your training over 12 months-so you can get qualified without financial pressure.

Ready to Make the Change?

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer your questions and help you take the first step towards a new, rewarding career in Human Resources.

title: Customer Service Advisor - Welsh Speaking/Written
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Advisor - Fluent Welsh Speaking and Written

Location: Remote
Contract Type: Temporary
Working Hours: Full-time, 6-week rolling rota (Shifts between 8am-8pm Monday to Friday, and 9am-5:30pm Saturday/Sunday/Bank Holidays. One Saturday and one Sunday every 6 weeks.)

Exciting Opportunity Awaits!
Our client is seeking a dedicated Customer Service Advisor to provide vital support to customers during their time of need. This role involves being the first point of contact for both inbound and outbound calls, ensuring each customer interaction is handled with care and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage customer inquiries via telephone, email, and webchat, updating the system with call notes.
- Deliver exceptional service by proactively addressing concerns and aiming for first-time resolutions.
- Support customers in sensitive circumstances while maintaining professionalism and impartiality.
- Identify complex queries and escalate them to ensure fair outcomes.
- Adhere to company guidelines while providing clear and efficient responses.
- Update client systems accurately with all key information.
- Navigate multiple secure client systems to retrieve and record information.
- Ensure compliance with GDPR and data protection requirements.
- Conduct security checks and verify customer identities before discussing sensitive information.
- Maintain confidentiality and accuracy while managing sensitive information.
- Meet performance targets related to quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
- Identify and report potential security, fraud, or safeguarding concerns.

What You Will Need:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience in a fast-paced customer service environment (preferably within a contact centre).
- Strong IT skills and multitasking abilities.
- Excellent timekeeping and reliability.
- A suitable home-working environment with a quiet workspace and reliable broadband connection.

What Our Client Offers:
- Long-term ongoing assignments with regular opportunities for permanent roles.
- Up to 33 days of paid holiday per year (25 days plus 8 bank holidays).
- Weekly pay for your convenience.
- Access to Serco Mental Health & Wellbeing resources and inclusive support networks.
- Employee Assistance Programme to support your well-being.

Requirements for the Recruitment Process:
To participate in the recruitment process, candidates must provide:
- A full valid passport.
- Two proof of addresses.
- Evidence of living in the UK for the last 3 years.
- Proof of national insurance (P45/P60 or payslip).

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a BPSS check, including Right to Work checks, employment history verification, a DBS criminal record check, and a CTC Counter Terrorism Check.

Training Details:
- Training will consist of two weeks (Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm) followed by two weeks of on-the-job training with additional support.

This opportunity is perfect for enthusiastic individuals eager to make a difference in customer service while enjoying the flexibility of remote work. If you possess the required skills and qualities, consider applying for this exciting role!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

title: Accounts & Administration Assistant
description:
Blue Arrow is urgently recruiting for an Accounts & Administration Assistant to join our clients team based in the Llansamlet area.

Salary: Up to 27,000 pa

Hours of work: Mon - Fri 9am-5pm

Contract: Permanent

Our client is a well-established property management and chartered surveying firm, providing professional services across residential & commercial portfolios and are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented individual to support their finance and administrative operations.

The Accounts and Administration Assistant will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial and administrative functions of the business. This is a varied role requiring excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Main Responsibilities:
- Accounts Support
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable processes
- Reconcile bank statements and client accounts
- Process invoices, receipts, and payments
- Maintain accurate financial records and filing systems
- Support month-end and year-end financial reporting
- Liaise with clients and suppliers regarding account queries
- Administration duties
- Provide general administrative support to the team
- Manage incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
- Maintain office supplies and equipment
- Assist with document preparation, data entry, and filing
- Support property management tasks such as issuing tenancy agreements, notices, and correspondence
- Schedule appointments, meetings, and inspections

Skills/Qualifications required:
- Administration experience (essential)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English
- Previous experience in an accounts or administrative role (Land property sector experience desirable)
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- Experience with accounting software (e.g., Xero, Sage, QuickBooks) is an advantage
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Accounts experience (desirable)

If you feel you have the right experience for the above role, please submit your CV for immediate response.

Blue Arrow is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and is committed to helping find great work opportunities for great people.

company: AKA The Recruitment Specialists - Agency - Permanent

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established automotive business offering a competitive salary, a structured working pattern and long-term career prospects.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Location: Bridgend

Salary: up to £15.75 per hour

Hours: Between 30 and 40 hours per week

Vacancy Type: Permanent

SATI Services Ltd provides development, network support, accounting, administration, customer service and management services. They are a small business with plans to make a big impact in their field.

They are looking for a full time experienced Accounts Administrator to support the office manager. SATI are an equal opportunities employer and understand that their employees may have family commitments surrounding the hours they are able to work. Therefore the hours and pattern can be flexible and set anywhere between 30 and 40 hours per week

- Day-to-day accounts administration
- Running weekly and monthly reports for sales invoicing and self-billing
- Ensuring timely payments to affiliates and suppliers

- Locating and organising purchase invoices and receipts
- Update internal accounting databases and spreadsheets

- Good knowledge of basic accounting principles
- At least 2 years experience of working in a similar accounts role
- Good understanding of Excel
- Good working knowledge of online accounting software
- Good team player
- Attention to detail
- Self motivated
- Flexible approach to work
- Ability to work unsupervised
- Excellent communication skills
- Must have the right to work in the UK

Desirable Competencies
- Good understanding of all MS Office applications
- Knowledge of VAT returns

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for SATI Services Ltd, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Planning Administrator
description:
Planning Administrators - Why You Should Apply

An extra day off every month: This Planning Administrator role comes with an industry-leading flexitime scheme. After probation, you earn an extra day off every month. That's up to 12 extra days a year, plus 32 days' holiday, for family, hobbies, or a long weekend away.

Learn from people who've done it: You won't be dropped in at the deep end. The manager you report to has done this exact job. The training and support are genuinely there when you need them.

Perks that save real money: An electric vehicle lease scheme at reduced cost, plus a nursery support scheme that can save you thousands a year, and a health cash plan covering dental, optical and physio.

A varied, connected role: You'll be the go-to point of contact across the whole site. One minute you're out on the shop floor, the next you're talking orders with customer service and purchasing.

Your salary, benefits & hours of work
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Days: Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm, office-based in Bridgend
- 24 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays (32 days in total)
- Flexitime scheme: earn an extra day off every month once past probation
- Salary sacrifice pension (3% employer, 5% employee)
- Electric vehicle lease scheme, plus a tech purchase plan
- Nursery support, health cash plan and confidential counselling
- Free on-site parking with EV charging points

What you'll do as the Planning Administrator

As part of the operations team at an award-winning manufacturer, you'll keep information flowing between production, purchasing, and customer service so orders are met on time.
- Allocate realistic dates to customer orders, keeping track of what's already promised
- Update demand and production scheduling information in the ERP system (SAP)
- Monitor open orders and flag potential shortages or delays early
- Keep spreadsheets, trackers and business data accurate and reliable
- Work closely with the shop floor, orders and purchasing teams to keep everyone informed

What you'll need to apply for the Planning Administrator
- Experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally in supply chain, logistics or planning administration
- The confidence to communicate face-to-face with different teams, including out on the shop floor
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail while juggling several priorities at once
- Good general IT skills.

Interested?
